title: Broadcast a custom vault state-transition notification
summary: Shows how to subclass DXP.BaseNotification, implement a dispatch-only notification interface with fixed DispIds, and broadcast it synchronously or asynchronously, with a read-back of what AD called on the object.
phrasings: send a custom notification to Altium Designer

commands.name: BroadCast
commands.description: Create a ValidateStateTransitionNotification and broadcast it: Mode=async (IClient.BroadcastNotificationAsynchronously, the default) or Mode=sync (IClient.BroadcastNotification); returns the notification's number and state
commands.params: Type=<notification type, default empty>|Mode=async|sync (default async)|Confirm (flag, required for the vault types altium.dxp.validatestatetransition / altium.dxp.validatestatetransitionex)

commands.name: NotificationStatus
commands.description: Report the last notification broadcast: number, mode, type, Valid, Note, the members callers invoked on it and the services SupportsService was asked for
commands.params: Reset (flag, optional: forgets the last notification and restarts the numbering)
